source_text: These findings, replicated in studies of female sex workers' clients, indicated odds ratios of HIV infection 5- to 8-fold higher in uncircumcised men, attributing part of the risk to increased vulnerability to genital ulcers and other sexually transmitted infections that facilitate HIV entry.
